services.name: 7 Passenger Pontoon Rentals
services.desc: Explore the Indian, Banana River, and Sykes Creek! Duration Half Day: 4 Hours Full Day: 8 Hours About Rent our 7 Passenger Pontoon Boat, sail out on the river and watch dolphins and manatees or even a Rocket Launch! Just relax on one of the river islands and sandbars, explore the rivers, canal, or many of its tributaries for a relaxing day. Entertain friends and family while cruising at a gentle pace along the river’s edge. There’s so much to see, and you choose where you want to go as you captain the boat. All of our rentals have gas included, so you don’t need to worry about your trip being cut short. You will have space for a cooler and you can bring anything you want to make your trip
